parameters.query:
INSERT INTO vacancies (id, title, url, description, published_at)
   VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
   ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
   RETURNING id;

SELECT *
   FROM vacancies
   WHERE status = 'new' AND send_attempts < 3
   ORDER BY published_at
   LIMIT 15;

UPDATE vacancies
     SET send_attempts = send_attempts + 1,
         status = CASE WHEN send_attempts + 1 >= 3 THEN 'failed' ELSE status END
     WHERE id = $1;
